q0: What media player is used and how do I connect a computer to a TV (cables or Wi-Fi)?
a0:
The suite is designed for Windows 10/11 computers and laptops powered by the ultimate classic MPC-HC (Media Player Classic Home Cinema) media player, which is already included in the installer. The program is not installed directly inside Smart TVs because the RIFE AI neural network utilizes the PC graphics card's horsepower.

How to output video from a PC/laptop to a TV:
• Via cable (maximum quality at 60–144 Hz without lag): using an HDMI, DisplayPort, or USB Type-C (Thunderbolt) cable.
• Wirelessly over Wi-Fi (5 GHz / Wi-Fi 6): via Windows wireless display feature (Win + K keys / Miracast) or high-frequency streaming systems like Moonlight / Steam Link. (Note: Bluetooth transmits audio only; use cable or Wi-Fi for video).
q1: Does the software consume computer resources when I'm not watching a video?
a1: No, absolutely 0% resource usage! The TALOS module operates exclusively the moment a video file is opened in the MPC-HC media player. As soon as you close the player, memory and GPU resources are instantly freed.
q2: Do I need to configure anything manually after installation?
a2: No. The installer automatically sets up the MPC-HC media player, libraries, and registers all 54 DirectShow filter parameters in the Windows Registry. You simply open any movie — and it immediately plays at 60–144 FPS.
q3: How is this better than the Russian SVP 4 software?
a3: 1) A completely Ukrainian standalone development with no telemetry background services. 2) An honest Integer Multiplier (x2 = 48 FPS for 24 fps cinema and 60 FPS for 30 fps video) preserves 100% of original frames without the 'jelly' effect, halos, and micro-stutters that occur in SVP with fractional x2.5 multipliers. 3) Out-of-the-box support for the clean RIFE v4.6 neural network for 1080p/4K without hidden locks.
q4: How many devices does the license cover, what happens if I reinstall Windows, and how does the -50% tablet discount work?
a4:
1) Hardware Binding (1 License = 1 Device): Each purchased copy is activated on a single selected device (HWID) and permanently bound to your email address in our customer database.
2) Free Restoration Upon OS Reinstallation: Immediately after payment, you receive a receipt email with a lifetime download button. When reinstalling Windows on the exact same PC, your license is preserved for life.
3) Special Promo '1 PC (100%) + 1 Tablet (-50%)': Customers who have already purchased a full 100% license for their primary PC or laptop are eligible to obtain 1 additional TALOS LITE license with a -50% discount exclusively for their personal Windows 10/11 tablet!
